lead: I'm Moiz Ali. I build AI agents and automations in Tetovo, and I care most about what comes after the demo: evals, guardrails and an off switch.
photoAlt: Moiz Ali's GitHub avatar: a red rune on a black background
bio: I started with React in 2025, building a website for the Karakoram Alpine Club, a mountaineering club in northern Pakistan, and a run of small apps to learn the craft. In early 2026 I moved to automation: an n8n voice agent, then a workspace where creators hand tasks to AI agents.

I work best with small teams who have a repetitive job a person still does by hand: research, outreach, reporting, data entry. I like problems where a wrong answer is expensive, because that is where checks written in code earn their keep.

A project with me starts with the task as it is done today, then a working pipeline on real inputs, measured: what it costs, how long it takes and how often it is right. A person stays in the loop wherever a mistake would matter, and every run is logged so you can see what it did.
now: Building Concord, a supervisor that keeps multi-agent runs alive through crashes
Taking the cold outreach agent to its first real email, and measuring its reply classifier
Open to projects that take a repetitive job off a small team
